Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ كَلَّفْتَنِيْ مِنْ نَفْسِيْ مَا أَنْتَ أَمْلَكُ بِهِ مِنِّي
Translation: O Allah, You have entrusted me with my own self, over which You have more control than I do

Arabic text: وَقُدْرَتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيَّ أَغْلَبُ مِنْ قُدْرَتِي
Translation: And Your power over it and me is greater than my own power

Arabic text: فَأَعْطِنِيْ مِنْ نَفْسِيْ مَا يُرْضِيْكَ عَنِّي
Translation: So grant me from myself what pleases You about me

Arabic text: وَخُذْ لِنَفْسِكَ رِضَاهَا مِنْ نَفْسِيْ فِيْ عَافِيَة
Translation: And take for Yourself its pleasure from me in well-being
O Allah, I have no strength for hardship
And no patience for trials
And no power to endure poverty
So do not withhold my sustenance
And do not entrust me to Your creation
But take sole responsibility for my needs
And undertake my sufficiency

Arabic text: وَانْظُرْ إِلَيَّ وَانْظُرْ لِيْ فِيْ جَمِيْعِ اُمُورِي
Translation: And look upon me and look after me in all my affairs

Arabic text: فَإِنَّكَ اِنْ وَكَلْتَنِيْ إِلَى نَفْسِيْ عَجَزْتُ عَنْهَا
Translation: For if You entrust me to myself, I will be incapable of it
And I will not establish what is in my best interest

Arabic text: وَ اِنْ وَكَلْتَنِيْ إِلَى خَلْقِكَ تَجَهَّمُونِي
Translation: And if You entrust me to Your creation, they will frown upon me

Arabic text: وَ اِنْ أَلْجَأتَنِيْ إِلَى قَرَابَتِيْ حَرَمُونِي
Translation: And if You leave me to my relatives, they will deprive me

Arabic text: وَ اِنْ أَعْطَوْا أَعْطَوْا قَلِيْلًا نَكِدًا
Translation: And if they give, they give little and reluctantly
And they remind me of it for a long time
And they criticize me greatly
So by Your grace, O Allah, enrich me
And by Your greatness, raise me up
And by Your abundance, extend my hand
And by what is with You, suffice me

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And free me from envy
And restrain me from sins
And make me abstain from forbidden things
And do not embolden me towards disobedience
And make my desire with You
And my satisfaction in what comes to me from You
And bless me in what You have provided me
And in what You have granted me
And in the favors You have bestowed upon me
And make me in all my conditions

Arabic text: مَحْفُوظًا مَكْلُوءًا مَسْتُورًا مَمْنُوعًا مُعَاذًا مُجَارًا
Translation: Protected, guarded, veiled, defended, sheltered, and safeguarded

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَاقْضِ عَنِّيْ كُلّ مَا أَلْزَمْتَنِيهِ وَفَرَضْتَهُ عَلَيَّ لَكَ فِيْ وَجْه مِنْ وُجُوهِ طَاعَتِكَ
Translation: And fulfill on my behalf all that You have obligated me with and made incumbent upon me toward You in any aspect of Your obedience
Or toward any of Your creation

Arabic text: وَ اِنْ ضَعُفَ عَنْ ذٰلِكَ بَدَنِي
Translation: Even if my body is too weak for that
And my strength falls short of it
And my capability cannot reach it
And my wealth cannot encompass it
Nor can my possessions
Whether I remember it or forget it

Arabic text: هُوَ يَا رَبِّ مِمَّا قَدْ أَحْصَيْتَهُ عَلَيَّ
Translation: It is, O my Lord, from what You have already counted against me
And I have neglected it from myself
So fulfill it on my behalf from Your abundant gifts
And from the abundance of what is with You
For indeed You are All-Encompassing, Generous

Arabic text: حَتَّى لَا يَبْقَى عَلَيَّ شَيْ مِنْهُ
Translation: Until nothing of it remains upon me

Arabic text: تُرِيدُ أَنْ تُقَاصَّنِيْ بِهِ مِنْ حَسَنَاتِي
Translation: That You would want to settle with me from my good deeds

Arabic text: أَوْ تُضَاعِفَ بِهِ مِنْ سَيِّئاتِيْ يَوْمَ أَلْقَاكَ يَا رَبِّ
Translation: Or multiply from my sins on the day I meet You, O my Lord

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَارْزُقْنِيْ الرَّغْبَةَ فِيْ الْعَمَـلِ لَكَ لْآخِـرَتِي
Translation: And grant me desire to work for You for my hereafter

Arabic text: حَتَّى أَعْرِفَ صِدْقَ ذٰلِكَ مِنْ قَلْبِي
Translation: Until I recognize the sincerity of that in my heart

Arabic text: وَحَتَّى يَكُونَ الْغَالِبُ عَلَيَّ الزُّهْدُ فِيْ دُنْيَايَ
Translation: And until detachment from this world becomes predominant in me
And until I perform good deeds out of longing

Arabic text: وَ آمَنَ مِنَ السَّيِّئاتِ فَرَقًا وَخَوْفًا
Translation: And remain safe from evil deeds out of fear and dread

Arabic text: وَهَبْ لِيْ نُورًا أَمْشِيْ بِهِ فِيْ النَّاسِ
Translation: And grant me a light by which I may walk among people
And be guided in darkness
And be illuminated from doubt and uncertainties

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And grant me fear of the distress of Your warnings

Arabic text: وَشَوْقَ ثَوَابِ الْمَوْعُودِ حَتَّى أَجِدَ لَذَّةَ مَا أَدْعُوكَ لَهُ
Translation: And longing for the reward You have promised until I find pleasure in what I call upon You for
And anxiety in what I seek Your protection from

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ قَـدْ تَعْلَمُ مَا يُصْلِحُنِيْ مِنْ أَمْرِ دُنْيَايَ وَ آخِـرَتِي
Translation: O Allah, You know what improves my affairs in this world and the hereafter
So be attentive to my needs

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّد
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: وَارْزُقْنِيْ الْحَقَّ عِنْدَ تَقْصِيرِيْ فِيْ الشُّكْرِ لَكَ
Translation: And grant me truth when I fall short in thanking You

Arabic text: بِمَا أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ فِيْ اليُسـرِ وَالْعُسْرِ وَالصِّحَّـةِ وَالسَّقَمِ
Translation: For the blessings You have bestowed upon me in ease and hardship, health and sickness

Arabic text: حَتَّى أَتَعَرَّفَ مِنْ نَفْسِيْ رَوْحَ الرِّضَا
Translation: Until I recognize in myself the comfort of contentment

Arabic text: وَطُمَأنِيْنَةَ النَّفْسِ مِنِّيْ بِمَا يَجِبُ لَكَ فِيمَا يَحْدُثُ
Translation: And the tranquility of my soul with what is due to You in whatever happens
In states of fear and security
Satisfaction and anger
Harm and benefit

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And grant me a heart free from envy

Arabic text: حَتَّى لَا أَحْسُدَ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ عَلَى شَيْءٍ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
Translation: So that I never envy any of Your creation for anything of Your bounty

Arabic text: وَحَتَّى لَا أَرَى نِعْمَـةً مِنْ نِعَمِـكَ عَلَى أَحَدَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
Translation: And so that I never see a blessing from Your blessings upon any of Your creation
In religion or worldly affairs
Or well-being or piety
Or abundance or comfort
Except that I hope for better than that for myself

Arabic text: بِكَ وَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
Translation: Through You and from You alone, with no partner to You

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّـدٍ وَ آلِـهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And grant me protection from sins

Arabic text: وَالْإِحْتِرَاسَ مِنَ الزَّلَلِ فِيْ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
Translation: And guard against error in this world and the hereafter
In states of contentment and anger

Arabic text: حَتَّى أَكُوْنَ بِمَا يَرِدُ عَلَيَّ مِنْهُمَا بِمَنْزِلَة سَوَاء
Translation: So that I may be, in whatever comes to me from both, at an equal level

Arabic text: عَامِلًا بِطَاعَتِكَ مُؤْثِرًا لِرِضَاكَ عَلَى مَا سِوَاهُمَا فِيْ الْاَوْلِيَاءِ وَالْأَعْدَاءِ
Translation: Working in Your obedience, preferring Your pleasure over all else regarding friends and enemies

Arabic text: حَتَّى يَأْمَنَ عَدُوِّيْ مِنْ ظُلْمِيْ وَجَوْرِيْ
Translation: Until my enemy feels safe from my injustice and oppression

Arabic text: وَيَيْأَسَ وَلِيِّيْ مِنْ مَيْلِيْ وَانْحِطَاطِ هَوَايَ
Translation: And my friend despairs of my partiality and deviation of my desires

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلنِيْ مِمَّنْ يَدْعُوكَ مُخْلِصًا فِيْ الرَّخَاءِ
Translation: And make me among those who call upon You sincerely in times of ease

Arabic text: دُعَاءَ الْمُخْلِصِينَ الْمُضْطَرِّينَ لَـكَ فِيْ الدُّعَاءِ
Translation: With the supplication of the sincere ones who are desperate for You in prayer
Indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious
